official.deadline_central_display: Applications are received online throughout the year
official.application_cycle: Rolling intake - applications are received online throughout the year
official.status_note: The scheme page states that applications are received online throughout the year; no closing date for a current round is published.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The scheme funds the foreign visit itself - economy class airfare, visa fee, travel insurance, local conveyance and maintenance - within prescribed Government notification norms; no tuition support is published.
benefits: The total expenditure on the foreign visit including economy class airfare, visa fee, travel insurance, local conveyance and maintenance, etc. should as per the prescribed norms as specified by the notifications of the Government.
The sanctioned amount towards maintenance will be released before commencement of the visit on submission of the copy of passport, visa procured, ticket and an undertaking.

In case of a scholar receiving air fare from any other source, 75% of the maintenance grant would be given in advance and remaining 25% after satisfactory submission of the relevant documents including Statement of Expenditure.
eligibility: Serving Indian Faculty members in ICSSR research institute/ICSSR recognized institutes/institutions of national importance as defined by the Ministry of Education/university/deemed university/colleges recognized by the UGC and having 12b status with Ph.D degree are eligible to apply.
Ph.D/PDF Indian scholars are also eligible to apply.

Assistance is aimed at ICSSR scholars who have proposed field work abroad in their original approved fellowship or project proposal and made substantial progress in their research, or any other independent scholar where data collection abroad is academically justified for research undertaken and are at an advance stage of their research.
requirements: Only those applications will be considered for assistance who have a letter from the libraries/archives/institutions, etc. in India stating non-availability of desired data.
Letter from the libraries/archives/institutions, etc. from abroad stating availability of the desired data and permission to access it.
Finalized schedules of primary/secondary data to be collected and appointment with the desired faculty/experts from the mentioned institutions.
Academic justification for the field visit especially when primary sources and data are available online.
The visit under this Scheme should be realistic and not more than of two weeks duration.
Application and reports should either be in English or Hindi.

After submitting the online application, a hard copy of the same, along with all enclosures, must be sent to the In-charge, IC Division, Indian Council of Social Science Research, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi 110067.
documents: Online application submitted through the ICSSR applicant portal at https://app.icssr.org/, plus a hard copy of the same with all enclosures sent to the In-charge, IC Division, ICSSR, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi 110067
Letter from the libraries/archives/institutions in India stating non-availability of the desired data
Letter from the libraries/archives/institutions from abroad stating availability of the desired data and permission to access it
Finalized schedules of primary/secondary data to be collected and appointments with the desired faculty/experts
Academic justification for the field visit
Copy of passport, visa procured, ticket and an undertaking (required for release of the maintenance amount before the visit)

Statement of expenditure indicating air ticket costs, visa fees, insurance charges, hotel bills, purchase of foreign currency bill and local airport transfers, along with photocopy of passport, immigration stamped paper and original boarding pass
Detailed report on the research work done during the visit (duly forwarded by the Supervisor in the case of students), with a copy of the collected data
Copies of air ticket, visa, original boarding pass, attendance certificate etc.
Copy of the final thesis/report/book brought out from the material collected, with due acknowledgement of the ICSSR
selection_criteria: Applications are initially scrutinised by the ICSSR Secretariat.

Thereafter an Expert Committee will select the meritorious proposals; the merit of the proposal and justification for foreign visit for field work would be the sole criteria of evaluation by the Expert Committee.
The recommendations of the Expert Committee are then placed before the Research Committee/Council for its final approval.
coverage: Local conveyance and local airport transfers
Maintenance for the period of the visit
Total expenditure on the foreign visit as per the prescribed norms specified by the notifications of the Government
application_method: Submit the online application through the ICSSR applicant portal at https://app.icssr.org/ - applications are received online throughout the year.
Send a hard copy of the application along with all enclosures to the In-charge, IC Division, Indian Council of Social Science Research, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi 110067.
Application and reports should either be in English or Hindi.
official.application_route: Apply online at https://app.icssr.org/ at any time of year and post the hard copy with all enclosures to the In-charge, IC Division, ICSSR, New Delhi 110067.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to Indian nationals - serving Indian faculty members and Indian Ph.D/PDF scholars in social science disciplines.
official.international_eligibility: No - the scheme funds Indian social science scholars travelling abroad for data collection; it is not open to foreign/international students.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Social sciences only. The broad disciplines within the domain of social sciences are: Sociology and Social Anthropology; Political Science/Public Administration; Economics; International Studies; Social Geography and Population Studies; Commerce and Management; Social Psychology; Education; Social Linguistics/Socio-Cultural Studies; Law/International Law; National Security & Strategic Studies; and other allied Social Science disciplines (Library Science, Social Work, Media Studies, Modern Social History, Health Studies, Gender Studies and Environmental Studies, Energy Studies, Diaspora Studies, Area Studies, Sanskrit-Society & Culture, etc.).
official.research_requirement: Data collection abroad must have been proposed in the scholar's original approved ICSSR fellowship or project proposal with substantial progress in the research, or be academically justified for an independent scholar whose research is at an advance stage; the application must document non-availability of the data in India and its availability with access permission abroad.
official.duration: The visit under this Scheme should be realistic and not more than of two weeks duration.
official.description: Under the Data Collection Abroad scheme, the ICSSR provides financial assistance to Indian Social Science Scholars who intend to visit abroad for the purposes of Data Collection or consulting Archival Material in connection with their research work. It is aimed at providing financial assistance to ICSSR scholars who have proposed field work abroad in their original approved fellowship or project proposal and made substantial progress in their research, or any other independent scholar where data collection abroad is academically justified and who are at an advance stage of their research.
official.program_type: Government research fieldwork grant (ICSSR International Collaboration programme)
official.english_requirement: No IELTS/TOEFL score is published; the guidelines state that the application and reports should either be in English or Hindi.

verification.notes: Scheme page and the official guidelines PDF dated 21-08-2026 both state only that total expenditure on the foreign visit is per the prescribed norms specified by the notifications of the Government - no fixed amount, currency or cadence is published anywhere on icssr.org. Eligibility, mandatory archive letters, selection route, release-of-grant mechanics, authorized travel agents and all post-visit conditions were confirmed in the guidelines PDF.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a reimbursement-style research travel grant rather than a scholarship: ICSSR pays the actual cost of one research visit of up to two weeks abroad - economy airfare, visa, insurance, local transport and daily maintenance - at Government of India notification rates, and publishes no fixed amount, so the sanction sanction is what sets the payable value. Applications roll in year-round through app.icssr.org, but approval needs an Expert Committee and then Research Committee/Council sign-off, so a realistic applicant starts several months before the intended travel dates. The decisive part of the file is documentary proof that the data simply does not exist in India and exists, with access permission, abroad.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Indian faculty with a PhD and Indian Ph.D/PDF scholars in social sciences whose approved or planned research genuinely requires a short overseas fieldwork or archive consultation trip.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure the two archive letters early: one from an Indian library/archive stating the desired data is not available there, and one from the foreign institution confirming availability plus permission to access - these are mandatory screens, not optional extras.
Attach a finalized schedule of the primary/secondary data to be collected with confirmed appointments with the faculty or experts you intend to meet.
Write an explicit academic justification for travelling in person, especially if any of the primary sources could be reached online - the guidelines specifically call this out.
Keep the itinerary within two weeks; a longer proposed visit falls outside the scheme.
Prepare the application and later the reports in English or Hindi only.

Register on app.icssr.org, submit online, then dispatch the hard copy with all enclosures to the In-charge, IC Division, ICSSR, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi 110067 - use a trackable courier, since ICSSR disclaims responsibility for postal delay or loss.
common_rejection_risks: Missing or informal archive correspondence - without the Indian non-availability letter and the foreign availability/permission letter the application will not be considered at all.
No convincing academic justification for a physical visit when the primary data is available online.
Incomplete applications, or institutional applications not duly forwarded by the institution (independent scholars are the only ones exempt from the forwarding rule).
Proposing fieldwork longer than two weeks, or work that was never part of the approved fellowship or project.
Reapplying too soon - a second application is considered only after a gap of three years, and the award can be availed only twice in a lifetime.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Anything beyond the prescribed Government norms: extra days beyond the two-week cap, anything above economy class, personal incidentals, and any expense without a valid receipt; unspent balance must be refunded to ICSSR.
document_audit: Economy air tickets must be booked only through the three authorized travel agents - M/s Ashoka Travels and Tours (ATT), M/s Balmer Lawrie & Company Ltd (BLCL) or IRCTC - tickets bought elsewhere risk non-reimbursement.
Keep the original boarding pass, the immigration-stamped passport pages and the foreign-currency purchase bill; settlement is documentary, so a missing paper means an unpaid cost.
If airfare comes from any other source, only 75% of the maintenance grant is advanced and the remaining 25% is released only after a satisfactory Statement of Expenditure.
For students, the post-visit report must be duly forwarded by the Supervisor and a copy of the collected data must accompany it.
The claim pack needs an attendance certificate plus copies of the air ticket and visa alongside the expenditure statement.
alerts: No published figure: ICSSR funds actual expenditure within Government notification norms, so you cannot budget a fixed stipend in advance - the sanction order determines what is payable.
Applications that were not approved will not be reconsidered, and the Council reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason.
Preference is given to applicants having proficiency in the native language of the country of visit.
ICSSR may ask for copies of the tickets booked and visa obtained before departure as a monitoring step - do not travel first and inform later.
Any monograph or book brought out from the material collected under the scheme must acknowledge ICSSR funding, with a copy sent to ICSSR.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply online at app.icssr.org at any point in the year, post the hard copy with enclosures to the IC Division in New Delhi, then wait for Secretariat scrutiny, Expert Committee shortlisting and Research Committee/Council sanction; the maintenance grant is released before departure and the balance is settled as reimbursement after the visit on the statement of expenditure.
